title: Metrics
lede: How the guards behave at the till: what they fire, what the pharmacists do with it, the money they protect, and where the payers still reject. Read-only.

access.deniedHint: Ask for the insurance rules grant to read the metrics.

window.label: Window
window.invalid: Pick a real start and end date.
window.reversed: The end date is before the start date.
window.tooLong: Pick a window of a year or less.
window.outOfBounds: The window is outside the days the metrics keep.

metrics.failed: The metrics could not be loaded.
metrics.empty: No guard fired in this window.

chart.caption: Fires per day
chart.hint: Point at a day to read its fires.

flags.neverPause: A flag never pauses a rule; it asks someone to look at it.
flags.thresholds: A rule is noisy when more than <v>{{noisyPct}}%</v> of at least <v>{{noisyMinFires}}</v> fires in <v>{{windowDays}}</v> days were overridden, silent after <v>{{silentDays}}</v> days with no fire, and jumps when it fires <v>{{jumpFactor}}</v> times its previous average. A flag never pauses a rule.

reason.jump: <v>{{fires}}</v> fires against a previous average of <v>{{previous}}</v> (<v>×{{factor}}</v>)
reason.jumpFromNone: <v>{{fires}}</v> fires where it used to fire none

rejections.lede: The payers' rejections by code, payer and kind of medicine, ranked by SAR. A kind with no live guard is where a new guard would earn most.
